title: Site
purpose: Review one site: its time zone, its rooms with their occupancy, and its history.
summary: One site: its time zone, its rooms with their occupancy, and its history.

tasks.title: Find space in a room
steps: Select a position in the list to open its cell in the box grid.

tasks.title: Change the site
steps: Select [[Edit]] to change the name or time zone, with a reason.

good_to_know: Sites cannot be retired or deleted.
Counts cover active boxes in active structure only.
The history lists each change with who made it and why.

items.label: Time zone
items.description: IANA time zone recorded as a setup fact. Times in forms use the repository's time zone.

items.label: Set up
items.description: When and by whom the site was created.

sections.title: Rooms
paragraphs: Position counts cover positions in active boxes that sit in active racks, shelves and storage units. Retired structure is never counted as capacity. Installed is every such position; Blocked are positions held out of use; Occupied have an item stored in them; Free is installed minus blocked minus occupied. Free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.
A positive Free count opens the available positions in that room. Zero means there are currently none.

items.label: Add room
items.description: Admin and manager roles. Opens the room form with this site chosen.

items.label: Table
items.description: Code (opens the room), name, active storage units, positions, occupied and free.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and manager roles. Changes the name or time zone; a reason is required.

sections.title: Notes
paragraphs: Sites cannot be retired or deleted.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 recorded changes to this record, shown oldest to newest, each with its time, the person and the reason given. Setup entries carry no reason. History cannot be edited or deleted. With more than five entries the panel starts collapsed; select its heading to open or close it.
